subject: Tabby cat standing in profile on a wooden table, facing right

subject: Bearded man in a white polo wearing a gold crown, seated and facing the camera
set: Indoor room with a tiled ceiling, checkered floor and a chair
notes: Ceiling is visible above his head, so the camera looks up at him. He is centered with the crown at the top. His arm is blurred in the foreground. Comic crown gag.

subject: Group of cats (tan, black and white, white, tabby) nose to nose around a small prey animal
set: Outdoor grassy dirt ground with small flowers
notes: Cats form a circle around the prey in the center. The camera looks down on them. A tan cat is in the left foreground.

subject: Tan cat facing other cats with a dead prey animal between them
set: Grassy slope with a tree trunk
notes: Tan cat on the left, black, white and tabby cats overlapping on the right. Prey sits in the center on the ground. Background hill is flat and shallow.

subject: Man holding a spear standing over a dead spotted deer
set: Riverbank with grass, trees and a rock
notes: Diagonal composition with water at the upper left. Man on the left, deer lying center-right. Rock in the lower-right corner.

subject: Bearded man seated, holding something in his hand and gesturing toward the camera
set: Dining room with a framed forest painting, wallpaper and green wainscot
notes: Man centered and facing the camera. Painting is centered behind his head, which gives symmetry. Hand is blurred in the foreground.

subject: Tabby cat walking toward the camera on the table
set: Dining room with a window and chair, dark table

subject: Man seated at a table with food, cat standing on the table facing him

notes: Man at the left foreground with his back partly to the camera, cat in the center. Plates are spread across the table. Diagonal room perspective.

subject: Tabby cat standing on the table with its head turned right, looking sideways
